data.name: Hunt Asylum Together
data.detailed_description:
Enter the asylum. Find the books. Break the curse. Survive together.

You were once a doctor inside this abandoned asylum — a place where patients were tortured, experimented on, and left to suffer. But the past did not die with them.

Now the asylum is cursed.

The patients you once hurt have returned as twisted, relentless creatures, hunting anyone who dares to step inside. Armed with weapons, a flashlight, your fists, and a signal radar, you and your team must search the haunted wards for cursed books and destroy the evil that still lives within the walls.

But every book brings you closer to the truth…
and every step brings them closer to you.

A 1-4 Player Co-op Horror Shooter

Play alone or team up with up to 4 players in a chaotic co-op horror experience. Work together, split up at your own risk, cover each other, manage your ammo, and survive the madness hidden inside the asylum.

One player can track cursed books with the radar while others defend against incoming enemies — but when the lights go out and the creatures rush in, teamwork can quickly turn into panic.

Hunt the Cursed Books

Your main objective is simple: find the hidden books scattered throughout the asylum and break the curse.

Use your radar to track them down, explore dark rooms, search abandoned wards, and uncover the secrets left behind. But be careful — not every signal leads to safety.

Some doors should stay closed.
Some hallways are not empty.
And some patients still remember what you did.

Fight, Run, or Punch Your Way Out

You are not defenseless.

Use different weapons to fight back against cursed patients, conserve your ammo, and stay alive when the asylum turns against you. If you run out of bullets, you can still rely on melee attacks and punches — but getting too close may be your last mistake.

Your flashlight is limited.
Your ammo is limited.
Your time is limited.

The asylum is not.

Multiple Game Modes

Hunt Asylum Together offers different ways to experience the horror:

Book Hunt Mode
Search for cursed books, survive the enemies, and break the curse before it’s too late.

Survival Mode
Face waves of enemies and see how long you and your team can last.

PvP Mode
Turn the asylum into a battleground and fight against other players in intense multiplayer chaos.

Horror, Action, and Multiplayer Chaos

Hunt Asylum Together blends creepy atmosphere, fast-paced shooting, co-op teamwork, and unpredictable horror moments. Whether you are carefully exploring with your flashlight or screaming with your friends while being chased through the halls, every match creates a new story.

Expect panic.
Expect chaos.
Expect betrayal, laughter, fear, and close calls.

Features

  • 1-4 player online co-op gameplay

  • Creepy abandoned asylum setting

  • Cursed book hunting objective

  • Radar-based tracking system

  • Multiple weapons and melee attacks

  • Limited flashlight system

  • Different enemy types

  • Book Hunt, Survival, and PvP game modes

  • Fast, chaotic, and replayable horror action

  • Perfect for playing with friends

You created the nightmare.
Now you have to survive it.

Grab your flashlight.
Load your weapon.
Trust your team.
And break the curse before the asylum claims you forever.

data.short_description: Hunt Asylum Together is a 1-4 player co-op horror action game. Use your radar to find hidden cursed books inside an abandoned asylum, fight terrifying enemies with weapons and melee attacks, and work together to break the curse. But be careful — the past is still alive inside these walls.
